portfolios.name: Wick Hunter
portfolios.description: A robot without AI reads prices every 5 seconds. When a contract moves more than 4.5% in 5, 15 or 30 minutes (a wick), it plays the reversal: it buys after a drop and sells after a rise, at 2x the portfolio, with a 5% stop. It exits 60 minutes after entry, then stays out of that contract for 60 minutes. On the bench, the gain disappears with delay: speed is the whole strategy.

portfolios.description: A cash substitute: it earns the funding paid by leveraged longs, with no bet on price. BTC and ETH, each a long spot leg and a short perpetual leg of equal size (€250 per leg), left alone unless a leg drifts outside 0.8 to 1.25 times its target. The spot leg is a valuation at the index price (the league has no spot instrument), with a 0.40% fee and 5 bp of slippage per spot trade. Expect a few percent a year at best: +2.1% a year over 2024-2026, +7.1% over 2020-2025 on Binance data.
